scripts.postinstall: npx puppeteer browsers install chrome || echo 'Chrome installation skipped (likely in Docker)'

scripts.cloud:deploy: gcloud run deploy cvgenerator --image europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/cv-generator-475321/cvgen-image/cvgen-backend:latest --region europe-west1 --platform managed --set-secrets=SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON=firebaseServiceAccount:latest
